#### 🔀 变更说明 | Description of Change

- close #8418
- close #8554

解决下述错误：
```
{
  "error": {
    "type": "invalid_request_error",
    "message": "Invalid request: the message at position 1 with role 'assistant' must not be empty"
  },
  "endpoint": "https://api.moonshot.cn/v1",
  "provider": "moonshot"
}
```

另去除模型内置搜索，因 lobechat 不支持。

#### 📝 补充信息 | Additional Information

<!-- Add any other context about the Pull Request here. -->

## Summary by Sourcery

Filter out empty assistant messages to prevent invalid requests and disable browser requests for Moonshot provider to avoid CORS errors

Bug Fixes:
- Remove assistant messages with empty content before sending payload to Moonshot API

Enhancements:
- Add disableBrowserRequest setting to Moonshot model provider configuration to work around CORS issues
